mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, the weather is clear near Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 50 degrees, though it feels like 43. We have a First Quarter moon tonight, and you can expect an overnight low of 42 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has announced that the school bus driver arrested last Thursday for O W I is currently under investigation, while city staff continue to update zoning ordinances and polling location information for all residents.
Looking ahead, residents can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, followed by a busy Monday, October 20 with trivia at both Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving behavior; fortunately, no students were injured during the event.
Today's flavor was Mint Cookie, but the store is now closed for the evening. Please join us tomorrow when the shop opens at 10:00 AM to enjoy the new flavor of the day, Caramel Peanut Buttercup.
